title: Install Pudicus inspection gate: hook, receipts, PR gate

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chore opened to install Pudicus (pudicus v0.1.2 from PyPI) into BotSpy. Scope: reproducible commit-msg hook install, HMAC receipt trailers on every commit, GitHub Actions PR gate with required status check. Gate will verify only commits new in a PR; merge commits and release-plz/github-actions bot commits are exempted per design. Sequenced after the pending history anonymization force-push; branch rebased onto new develop before enabling the required check.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #10 opened (cursor/pudicus-install-b3b8 -> develop). Installed: .pudicus.yml (gitleaks checker), scripts/setup-pudicus.sh (pinned pudicus==0.1.2 in per-user venv, commit-msg hook into common git dir, shared secret), scripts/pudicus_gate.sh + .github/workflows/pudicus-gate.yml (check name pudicus-receipt-gate: verifies receipts of commits new to the base branch via pudicus verify pooling, re-runs gitleaks; merge commits and github-actions/release-plz bot commits exempt; pre-gate history grandfathered). docs/pudicus.md + AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md updated. Repo secret PUDICUS_SECRET set. Demos: fake-secret commit blocked by hook (exit 1); unsigned-commit demo PR #11 failed the gate and was closed. Waiting on: full CI green, then the history anonymization force-push, then rebase onto new develop, then ruleset making pudicus-receipt-gate required on develop+main (github-actions integration bypassed so release.yml can push to main), then merge.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Taken over 2026-10-04 after the bot fleet stopped (PR #10 had been closed unmerged). Branch chore/pudicus-0.2-gate merges cursor/pudicus-install-b3b8 onto current develop and upgrades to pudicus 0.2.0: replaces the hand-written .gitleaks.toml with the shipped ruleset at .pudicus/gitleaks.toml (adds OpenAI/Anthropic keys, wallet keys, Windows home paths, user_id/author_id, Kanbus-aware UUID allowlist), pins 0.2.0 in setup script and CI gate.

right_now_summary: The branch now upgrades Pudicus to 0.2.0 and uses its shipped gitleaks ruleset.
